Kenneth R. Casner

Democratic candidate for Governor, Wyoming · Open seat

Kenneth R. Casner is the Democratic nominee for Wyoming governor in the November 3, 2026 general election, and WyoFile's election guide lists him as an active candidate. He was the first Democrat to announce a run for governor in 2026. This is his third campaign for the office, and he has called it his "last hurrah."

Where Casner stands

Campaign finance
Says he is taking no campaign money, and says truth-telling and refusing donations are the core of his campaign.

Background

  • Democratic nominee for Wyoming governor, 2026 (his third run for governor)
  • Took part in the 2018 Democratic gubernatorial primary debate
  • Age 75 (Casper Star-Tribune, 2026)
